name: degoog_extentions
description: Personal degoog extensions: engines, plugins and tools.
author: AromaticTurtle

plugins.name: Books (Hardcover)
plugins.description: Book panel in the side column from Hardcover: cover, authors, series, Hardcover rating and readers, genres, pages, description. Needs a free Hardcover API token (create it with only the read:catalog permission). Cached and capped to a daily request limit.

plugins.name: Board games (BoardGameGeek)
plugins.description: Board game panel in the side column from BoardGameGeek data: rating, rank, weight, players, playing time, designers, mechanics. Three optional sources with an automatic fallback: the BGG XML API (token, registration required), recommend.games (no key) and BGG's own website API (opt-in, off by default). Cached and capped by per-source daily limits.

plugins.name: Game info (IGDB + ProtonDB)
plugins.description: Video game panel in the side column: IGDB scores, platforms, developer, time to beat, ProtonDB Linux compatibility and a Steam link. Needs free Twitch/IGDB credentials. Cached.

engines.name: Marginalia
engines.description: Marginalia Search (small, non-commercial web) through its API. Needs a free API key. One request per page, spaced out, with a cool-down after rate limiting.

engines.name: Mojeek
engines.description: Mojeek web search without an API key. Passes Mojeek's small proof-of-work check once a month, then each search is one request. Bounded, paused after blocks.

engines.name: Mwmbl
engines.description: Mwmbl, the non-profit community search engine, on the web tab. Works without a key. One request per search; later pages come from a 10 minute cache. Tidies Mwmbl's rough results.

engines.name: OpenAlex
engines.description: Scholarly works from OpenAlex on a Scholar tab. Works without a key; a free key raises the daily budget. Stops when the daily budget is spent.

engines.name: CORE
engines.description: Open access research papers from CORE on a Scholar tab. Needs a free API key. Paced to CORE's small quota.

engines.name: Unsplash
engines.description: Unsplash photos on the Images tab through the official API. Needs a free API key. Credits the photographer with their profile address.

engines.name: selfh.st
engines.description: Search the selfh.st self-hosted app directory on an Apps tab, including its alternative-to lists. Downloads the list once, caches it on disk and searches locally.

favicon.name: selfh.st icons
favicon.description: Real app logos from selfh.st/icons for self-hosted software sites (n8n.io, jellyfin.org and about 830 more). Unknown hosts fall through to the next provider. Drag it above Google in Settings, Favicons.
